privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Here we explain what information {{appName}} handles, what it is used for and how you can exercise your rights.

s1.title: 1. Controller and scope
s1.body:
{{appName}} —also presented as Cultura General— is run by Pablo Brasero, an independent developer based in Spain. Write to pablobrasero@gmail.com with any privacy question.

This policy covers the iOS and Android app and its official website. The full, always-current version lives at cg-trivia.pablobrasero.com/en/privacy.

s2.title: 2. Information we process
s2.body:
To create an account we handle your email address, the username you choose and an internal identifier. If you sign in with Apple or Google, the identity provider supplies the data needed to authenticate you according to the permissions you accept.

We also store answers, progress, streaks, scores, records, level, achievements, coins, shop items, friendships and reports needed to run the game features.

• Technical app and device data, such as version, operating system, language and error logs.
• Advertising attribution data —including campaign, IP address and advertising identifier— only where applicable and once you have granted the required permissions.
• We do not request precise location, contacts, photos, camera, microphone or calendar.

s3.title: 3. How we use data
s3.body:
• Creating, authenticating, protecting and recovering your account.
• Showing your profile, progress, statistics, achievements and unlocked content.
• Calculating rankings, streaks and results, and enabling friendships and social features.
• Preventing abuse, investigating reports and keeping the service safe.
• Diagnosing failures and improving how the app works.
• Showing ads and measuring campaigns only under the privacy choices described below.

We do not sell or rent your personal data.

s4.title: 4. Data visible to other players
s4.body: Your username, avatar or public customization, level, streak and certain statistics or ranking positions may be visible to other authenticated users. Your email, credentials and individual answers are not shown publicly.

s5.title: 5. Legal grounds
s5.body: We process the data needed to provide the service and perform the terms of use; to comply with legal obligations; and, where applicable, on the legitimate interest of protecting and improving the app. Personalized advertising, cross-app tracking and certain measurement rely on your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

s6.title: 6. Providers
s6.body:
We use Supabase for authentication, database and server functions; Sentry to diagnose errors; AppLovin MAX for advertising; AppsFlyer for attribution; and Meta to measure campaigns when you have chosen personalized ads and system permissions allow it. Apple and Google may also handle information when distributing the app or authenticating you.

You can review each provider's policy at cg-trivia.pablobrasero.com/en/privacy.

s7.title: 7. Advertising, age and attribution
s7.body:
Before initializing any advertising system we ask for an age bracket and an informed choice. Ads, when they appear, show up at natural breaks in play: the result of the daily question, the end of a Time Attack run, a Climb Mode run or a World round, and before or after an Adventure level. We never show banners while Adventure questions are being answered.

• Under 16: we do not initialize AppLovin, AppsFlyer or Meta, and you can use the whole app without ads.
• Contextual ads: we tell AppLovin that you do not consent to personalization and that data must not be sold or shared for targeted advertising. We do not ask for App Tracking Transparency and we do not start AppsFlyer or Meta.
• Personalized ads: on iOS we first ask for the official App Tracking Transparency permission. AppLovin may process identifiers and advertising activity to select, cap and measure ads; AppsFlyer and Meta may measure installs and campaign events.

You can review or change your choice under Profile > Settings > Privacy and ads. Switching to contextual stops new personalized measurement requests.

s8.title: 8. Notifications
s8.body: If you turn them on, {{appName}} sends you a daily reminder at 9:00 so you do not lose your streak. They are local notifications: your own device schedules them and their content never travels through a server. You can turn them off whenever you want under Profile > Settings or in your system settings.

s9.title: 9. Diagnostics and security
s9.body:
Sentry may receive the technical stack of the error, app and system versions and an internal identifier used to group incidents. We configure the service to reduce personal data and to deliberately avoid sending your email, username or question content.

Communications use HTTPS/TLS, passwords are never stored in plain text and we apply access controls on the database. No system is infallible, but we keep measures proportionate to the risk.

s10.title: 10. Retention and transfers
s10.body: We keep your account and progress while it is active or until you ask us to delete it. Certain technical logs, backups or data needed to prevent fraud and meet obligations may remain for limited periods. Some providers may handle information outside the European Economic Area under their applicable contractual and legal safeguards.

s11.title: 11. Your rights
s11.body:
Depending on where you live, you may request access, correction, deletion, objection, restriction and portability, and withdraw consent.

• You can delete your account under Profile > Danger zone, without leaving the app.
• You can change your advertising choice under Profile > Settings > Privacy and ads.
• On iPhone or iPad you can withdraw tracking permission under Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking.
• For any other request, write to us at pablobrasero@gmail.com.

You may also complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency or your local authority.

s12.title: 12. Children
s12.body: {{appName}} is a general-audience app and is not directed exclusively at children. AppLovin does not allow its SDK to be used with anyone who is a minor under applicable law, and that age varies by country: we apply a single cut-off of 16, the highest required across the European Economic Area. We do not use advertising or attribution SDKs with anyone who states they are under 16. If you believe a child has given us information without authorization, contact us so we can review and delete it where appropriate.

s13.title: 13. Changes to this policy
s13.body: We will update this policy if features, providers or legal requirements change, and we will publish the new version with its effective date. You can always check the current version at cg-trivia.pablobrasero.com/en/privacy.
